name: Alpsee Camping
beschreibung: The **Alpsee Camping** campsite is located in **Immenstadt im Allgäu**, right by the shores of **Alpsee**. The site is surrounded by the mountain ranges of the **Allgäu Alps** and situated in a peaceful, nature-rich setting. The area offers marked **hiking trails**, as well as several **ski resorts** in winter. The campsite provides **pitches** for motorhomes, caravans, and tents with electricity and fresh water hookups. The **facilities** include shower cabins and washrooms. Guests have access to the lake for activities like swimming or boating. The location serves as an ideal starting point for excursions into the surrounding mountain and lake landscapes.
